description: SplitEasy is a free expense ledger. After you connect your account, ChatGPT can show who you owe, who owes you, list friends and groups, preview an equal split, and add an expense in your name after you confirm. ChatGPT cannot settle up, itemize a receipt line by line, or delete your account. Works with the signed-in SplitEasy user only.

defaultPrompt: What do I owe, and who owes me?
Show my groups and recent activity.
Preview splitting $12 coffee equally with a friend, then add it only after I confirm.
